The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 04172 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 17 December - the folder's feast day. The day's four plates are Daniel, Ananias, Azarias and Misael, and Commons files this one under Category:Fiery furnace. This is the second, captioned Anania - the Three Youths are commemorated with Daniel on this day and this plate is the folder's own youth, Ananias. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
